## Plea Bargains
For sentences of at least 15 minutes, but not those classified as Capital Crimes, prisoners may request a Lawyer to obtain a plea bargain. In these cases, Internal Affairs Agents will represent the Marine Police. In this situation, Internal Affairs Agents are expected to obtain the Marine Police's records of the crime, and are to negotiate on behalf of the Marine Police. Upon reaching a conclusion, this deal should be presented to the Marine Quartermaster, but the Marine Quartermaster is not obligated to accept it. A second bargain may be attempted if the first is rejected, but after a second rejection, the prisoner must wait out their sentence.
In the absence of Internal Affairs Agents, the Marine Quartermaster is within their right to deny this request outright.
